messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to finalize the micro-drip + newsletter handoff for the webinar invite. Goal: drive signups and route hot leads to SDRs same-day. Who's owning segmentation?
ben: I can take segmentation. thinking 3 tiers: engaged (last 30d opens/ctr), warm (30-90d), cold (90+). Thoughts? :thinking_face: 
emily: +1 on tiers. For engaged let's do personalized subject + early-bird CTA, warm gets webinar intro + benchmark teaser, cold gets newsletter-style value first.
josh: For routing, can we send engaged leads straight to the priority queue via webhook? SDRs want <1h SLA.
sofie: Yes — we have the webhook ready. Need score threshold though. Suggest score >= 75 => immediate route, 50-74 => drip + nurture, <50 => long-term cadence.
maria: Sounds good. Ben — can you provide the segment queries by EOD so ops can wire the hooks? Also need send windows per segment (avoid Tue morning overload).
ben: On it. Draft queries (examples):
```
engaged: last_open<=30d AND recent_event:clicked_cta
warm: last_open>30d AND last_open<=90d
cold: last_open>90d AND no_clicks
```
I'll push full SQL to the doc.
emily: Subject line tests — propose A/B across engaged only:
A: "You're invited — early access to Redwood's Q2 inference benchmarks"
B: "See how teams cut inference costs 2x — live webinar"
Run opens on 1k sample first.
josh: Also add a variant with emoji for mobile: "🚀 Live: Q2 inference benchmarks + cost hacks"
sofie: For tracking, add utm_campaign=webinar_q2_microdrip and utm_segment=<segment>. Ops needs final mapping.
marketing-bot: Reminder: webinar doc updated — https://redwood.work/webinar-q2 (edited)
maria: Thanks — action items: 1) Ben: seg SQL + list export by 5pm. 2) Emily: finalize 3 subject variants and schedule A/B sample. 3) Josh: confirm webhook SLA and add route logic. 4) Sofie: update tracking template and lead score thresholds. I'll run a dry send to our team list Thurs AM. Any risks?
emily: Risk: engaged volume might exceed SDR capacity — recommend cap at 500/day and FIFO.
ben: Noted — I'll add capping logic to the export.
josh: Ops: can we auto-fallback to weekly digest if SDR queue full?
sofie: Yes — fallback to "webinar digest" drip and mark as follow-up in CRM.
maria: Perfect. I'll post the finalized schedule + send checklist after the dry run. :thumbsup:
emily: Quick note — include a one-question poll in pre-webinar email to boost QA for sales (topic interest). small ask increases reply-rate.
marketing-bot: Calendar invite: Q2 webinar send ops check — Thu 10:00 AM.
maria: Great. Closing thread — ping me if anything blocks the EOD deliverables.
